info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Careers Applications Referrals-v5-spec
info.description: The Careers Applications Referral API provides an efficient way to access referral details for job applications. Users can retrieve a list of referrals associated with careers applications, enabling companies to track the success and effectiveness of their referral programs. This API is particularly useful for HR teams and recruiters who wish to analyze referral trends and candidate origins. With seamless integration, organizations can enhance their hiring processes and improve the overall talent acquisition strategy.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve a list of referral applications submitted to the system. You can use this to view and manage all existing referral applications.
